description: Report a background job started by build_start, check (ready), repair_propose or rerecord: status running|done|failed, the last progress lines, and the final JSON result and exit code when finished. Waits up to wait_s seconds for the job to finish before answering.

job_id.description: The job_id a job-starting tool returned.

wait_s.description: Long-poll: wait up to this many seconds for completion (default 25, max 50).

name: job_status
